dct_description_sm: Zimbabwe administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 10 Province - Admin 2: 91 District - Admin 3: 1961 Ward Dates associated with this dataset: - 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 11 September 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 31 August 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 31 August 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency (ZIMSTAT www.zimstat.co.zw) Central Statistics Office
